title: Redis transport: binding key never expires for a queue declared with expires
author: ChristianMurphy
body_preview: Thanks for kombu. I think I've found a small gap in the Redis transport's queue expiry.  When a queue is declared with `expires`, the transport sets a TTL on the queue's message lists. The `_kombu.binding.<exchange>` set written in `_queue_bind` never gets one. With one queue per worker, each replaced worker leaves its binding set behind for good. title: RQ cron scheduler does not respect Django TIME_ZONE
author: chromium7
body_preview: ## Summary  Cron expressions registered through `django_rq` are evaluated in UTC instead of the timezone configured in Django's `TIME_ZONE`.  For example, with `TIME_ZONE = "Asia/Jakarta"`, a cron expression intended to run at `08:25` is scheduled for `08:25 UTC` and therefore runs at `15:25` Jakarta time.  ## Environment  - django-rq: 4.2.0 - rq: 2.12.0 - Django `TIME_ZONE`: `Asia/Jakarta` - Djan...

author: RealOrangeOne
